name: American Samoa
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); no territorial standard found

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: American Samoa Government and its agencies as a Title II 'State' (42 U.S.C. 12103).

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).
ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).

requires: Federal floor: WCAG 2.1 AA for web content and mobile apps, subject to 28 CFR 35 exceptions
mobile: implied — only via the federal rule.
procurement: No territorial accessibility procurement rule found.
enforcement: ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ; no territorial path found.
notes: No American Samoa Code or Department of Technology accessibility policy found. The 2020 Census population is believed to be under 50,000 (about 49,700), which would make the 2028-04-26 date apply, but this was not verified; both dates are listed. One agency page (HCBS) claims 'WCAG 3.0 level A', which is not a real conformance target.
